shots.title: The open sedan door
shots.targetText: Its rear door stands open: warm amber light, leather.
shots.prompt: Create one horizontal 16:9 photorealistic film still for Nobody's Witness at beat nw_b1562. Use both neighbouring reference images for the same rain-soaked black sedan, beige leather interior and warm amber cabin light. Show a distinct closer three-quarter view from the wet pavement of the open rear door and the inviting empty seat nearest the door. The same silver-haired older Japanese man in a dark suit remains quietly seated on the far side, as in the first reference; the driver is only a dim silhouette. Match the real car's black bodywork, rain droplets, leather and lighting. Ishida has not yet entered this shot; do not add another person beside the car. Restrained Tokyo-noir photographic realism, natural proportions, no captions, titles, readable added text, logos or watermark. A complete wide landscape frame, not a square or a tight crop.

shots.title: Vera asks about Mara
shots.targetText: My sister. Four nights ago. Was she here?
shots.prompt: Create one horizontal 16:9 photorealistic film still for Nobody's Witness at beat nw_b199. The first two references establish the same narrow, dim Kanda bar, elderly owner Okada in a dark apron and white shirt, and Vera holding up a phone; the third reference identifies Vera's face and clothes only. Show a distinct medium two-shot of the same blonde Vera in her dark coat and cream turtleneck politely asking Okada about her missing sister while holding her phone toward him. The back of the phone faces the camera, so its picture is not invented or readable. Okada looks at her before the following close-up. Keep the same wet windows, bottles, bar stools and subdued rainy daylight. Natural hands, quiet tension, no new foreground people, no captions, subtitles, added readable words or watermark. Wide landscape composition with comfortable headroom.
